harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired bin/replay and recovered the spool successfully. Delivery is deduplicated by Message-ID, same-subject distinct messages are preserved, reruns are idempotent, malformed mail is explained in quarantine, and all state survived node1’s verified reboot.
actions_performed: Replaced replay with a POSIX /bin/sh implementation compatible with the installed Ubuntu 24.04 platform.
Delivered <a@branch.test> once and the distinct <b@branch.test> message separately.
Preserved all four original spool files and the existing old.eml delivery.
Verified reruns skip indexed Message-IDs without modifying deliveries or index.tsv.
Safely restarted node1 and verified its changed boot identity and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Recover once per Message-ID without losing distinct same-subject messages
evidence.summary: The first run delivered IDs a and b separately despite both having Subject: Notice; the duplicate a entry was skipped and each ID occurs once in the index.

evidence.requirement: Rerunning recovery skips entries already recorded in delivered/index.tsv
evidence.summary: Normal and post-restart reruns skipped all indexed valid messages; index and delivery hashes remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the original spool and already-delivered message
evidence.summary: Initial, pre-restart, and post-restart checksums prove all spool files and delivered/old.eml remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Quarantine malformed messages with an explanation
evidence.summary: quarantine/bad.eml matches the source, and bad.eml.reason explains the invalid or missing Message-ID.

evidence.requirement: Retain the installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: The repaired POSIX shell script passes syntax validation; Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic are unchanged across restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45 was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 601e509a-5d92-442d-a863-73f3bb5c5deb observed, and system/data health passed afterward.
